*   `?g A8`: Main Concept is A8 (Idea / Intelligence / Concept).
    *   `+ G11`: Cube on G11 (Double arrow measuring a wide bar) in group `g`. This usually implies "Large" or "Wide" or "Significant" or a count.

    *   `+ G12`: Cube on G12 (Up arrow from floor) in group `r`. This usually implies "High" or "Up" or "Rise".
    *   `!y B14`: Sub-concept (yellow) is B14 (House – Dwelling / Room / Domestic).
